_autonomy_levels: simulation = actions run only against the simulator; supervised = missions are queued in state/pending_missions.json for human approval; autonomous = adapter may actuate (requires hardware adapter + explicit human change to this file)

location._note: SW corner of the field (x east, y north). Default: Iowa row-crop land for a real-data demo; set to your own field.

charging._note: charge = recharge in place between sorties (rate_w watts for turnaround_min); swap = spare batteries, instant full battery. Overnight the fleet always charges to full.

hardware._note: enabled + AGRIDRONE_ARMED=1 on the ground station are both required to fly. Set origin to your field's south-west corner.

weather._note: synthetic = seasonal generator (default, season starts at deployment). open-meteo = real data for the lat/lon; use it when day 1 is a real planting date.

imagery._note: enabled: the autopilot refreshes Sentinel-2 imagery when the cache is >max_age_days old (needs the 'imagery' extra and network).
